note: A7-owned test configuration. It is NOT game data and the game never reads it. Every value states whether it is a creator-locked rule, arithmetic derived from a locked rule, or an AI-chosen tunable that any owner may change without a new product decision. Probes read this file so a test can name the rule it is enforcing instead of hard-coding a number.
